_why: Dotted paths (list indexes as numbers) that may differ from a job host matrix cell's golden, keyed by the golden's file name without .json (e.g. medchron__delivered); <file> allows the file to appear or go. Each entry names one exact path; a wildcard is refused. Empty: no difference is allowed. A PR that changes a host's behaviour on purpose names each path it changes here; the edit is reviewed with the PR, and the integrity job (bin/goldens/golden-integrity.py) holds the committed goldens to the merge-base tree's behaviour everywhere else, fails on an entry that explains no difference or that the merge-base already carried, and on the push to main fails until a merged change's entries are cleared. #4011 (2026-11-13): the records and medchron ledgers gain reply_sent_at and reply_key (the reply-once mark, a defect Phase A pinned), so a records job row the broker returns carries both, null until replied. The lifecycle matrix and run record PR (2026-11-17): every chronology record carries a run block (fields.run on the wire, metadata.run on the audit row, run_pending in the state between a resume and its start); an ending the broker did not take is kept as record_pending and recorded on a later tick, while the firm's message goes as before (medchron__broker_down_mid_run); the new host ending queued_behind_same_lane is not applicable to the note, negotiation and library setup lanes.
